function: Use the meter element to display a scalar value within a given range (a gauge).

attributes.name: form
attributes.function: Specifies which form the <meter> element belongs to

attributes.name: high
attributes.function: Specifies the range that is considered to be a high value

attributes.name: low
attributes.function: Specifies the range that is considered to be a low value

attributes.name: max
attributes.function: Specifies the maximum value of the range

attributes.name: min
attributes.function: Specifies the minimum value of the range. Default value is 0

attributes.name: optimum
attributes.function: Specifies what value is the optimal value for the gauge

attributes.name: value
attributes.function: Required. Specifies the current value of the gauge
